sourcePublication: private workspace, verified archive and Git bundle; compiled release and QA tools only in public commits
onlineCompetition: implemented and locally verified; hosting not configured
googleLogin: implemented with signature tests; production client ID not configured
briefingTarget: bright red outlined target, slow pulse, reduced-motion static
hosting: GitHub Pages free beta; production API not connected
targetPlacementPolicy: equal full-map 4x4 cells clipped to safe bounds; stable across terrain and official difficulty retries

approachAudit.method: fixed-tick heading controller, all five starts, retained speed; not a human playtest

resultFeedback: post-impact top-down target/impact/release diagram, release-pose-relative signed errors and conditional advice; separate no-drop guidance
training: optional first-local-run steering/braking/one-drop lesson; explicit ready action, fixed separate course, real impact prediction, touch/keyboard, skip/retry/reopen, excluded records, normal rendering conceals hints
resultRendering: HTML first; one static overview after250ms; final board hides WebGL

playStats.scope: one browser, opt-in, rolling30KST calendar days
playStats.data: date and count/frame aggregates only; no identity/map/input/score
playStats.revocation: remove only stats; discard buffers; honor other-tab withdrawal
playStats.nextDay: number of consecutive-day play dates, not population D1 retention

flightHistory.scope: local personal record, last20 completed games since update
flightHistory.goal: next50-point milestone after latest score; capped at500; fallback to legacy best only when history empty

dogfight.mode: local AI finale after five bombing rounds; not multiplayer
dogfight.camera: FPS-style relative mouse look; aircraft follows yaw/pitch; fixed centre gun reticle
dogfight.mobile: drag the screen to aim/steer while holding FIRE; no altitude buttons
dogfight.rankings: current-game AI board and shared card include combat; legacy best/history/daily remain bombing-only; official server excludes combat
dogfight.earlyFinish: after player empties 100 rounds and own projectiles resolve
